verses.original: אֶפְרַ֜יִם רֹעֶ֥ה ר֙וּחַ֙ וְרֹדֵ֣ף קָדִ֔ים כָּל־ הַיּ֕וֹם כָּזָ֥ב וָשֹׁ֖ד יַרְבֶּ֑ה וּבְרִית֙ עִם־ אַשּׁ֣וּר יִכְרֹ֔תוּ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לְמִצְרַ֥יִם יוּבָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim rō·‘eh rū·aḥ wə·rō·ḏêp̄ qā·ḏîm kāl- hay·yō·wm kā·zāḇ wā·šōḏ yar·beh ū·ḇə·rîṯ ‘im- ’aš·šūr yiḵ·rō·ṯū wə·še·men lə·miṣ·ra·yim yū·ḇāl
verses.literal: Ephraim feeds on the wind and pursues the east wind all day long he multiplies lies and violence he makes a covenant with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt
verses.literalPt: Efraim apascenta o vento e caça o vento oriental; continuamente, multiplica mentiras e desolação; fazem aliança com a Assíria, e o azeite é levado para o Egito.

verses.original: וְרִ֥יב לַֽיהוָ֖ה עִם־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלִפְקֹ֤ד עַֽל־ יַעֲקֹב֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו כְּמַעֲלָלָ֖יו יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rîḇ Yah·weh ‘im- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·lip̄·qōḏ ‘al- ya·‘ă·qōḇ kiḏ·rā·ḵāw kə·ma·‘ă·lā·lāw yā·šîḇ lōw
verses.literal: The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah He will punish . . . Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds
verses.literalPt: Jeová tem uma controvérsia com Judá e visitará sobre Jacó os seus caminhos; conforme os seus feitos, lhe recompensará.

verses.original: בַּבֶּ֖טֶן עָקַ֣ב אֶת־ אָחִ֑יו וּבְאוֹנ֖וֹ שָׂרָ֥ה אֶת־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.literal: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel and in his vigor he wrestled with God
verses.literalPt: No ventre, pegou do calcanhar de seu irmão e, na idade varonil, perseverou com Deus;

verses.original: וָיָּ֤שַׂר אֶל־ מַלְאָךְ֙ וַיֻּכָ֔ל בָּכָ֖ה וַיִּתְחַנֶּן־ ל֑וֹ בֵּֽית־ אֵל֙ יִמְצָאֶ֔נּוּ וְשָׁ֖ם יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wāy·yā·śar ’el- mal·’āḵ way·yu·ḵāl bā·ḵāh way·yiṯ·ḥan·nen- lōw bêṯ- ’êl yim·ṣā·’en·nū wə·šām yə·ḏab·bêr ‘im·mā·nū
verses.literal: Yes, he struggled with the angel and prevailed he wept and sought His favor he found Him at Bethel and spoke with Him there
verses.literalPt: sim, perseverou com o anjo, e prevaleceu. Chorou e fez-lhe súplicas. Achou-o em Betel, e ali falou ele conosco,

verses.literal: the LORD God of Hosts the LORD is His name of renown
verses.literalPt: a saber, Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos; Jeová é o seu memorial.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה בֵּאלֹהֶ֣יךָ תָשׁ֑וּב חֶ֤סֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט֙ שְׁמֹ֔ר וְקַוֵּ֥ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh bê·lō·he·ḵā ṯā·šūḇ ḥe·seḏ ū·miš·pāṭ šə·mōr wə·qaw·wêh ’el- ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: But you must return to your God maintain love and justice and always wait on your God
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, converte-te ao teu Deus; guarda a misericórdia e o juízo e espera sem cessar no teu Deus.

verses.original: כְּנַ֗עַן בְּיָד֛וֹ מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִרְמָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אָהֵֽב׃
verses.literal: A merchant loves to defraud with dishonest scales in his hands
verses.literalPt: Canaã! Na sua mão, está a balança enganosa; ama a opressão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶפְרַ֔יִם אַ֣ךְ עָשַׁ֔רְתִּי מָצָ֥אתִי א֖וֹן לִ֑י כָּל־ יְגִיעַ֕י לֹ֥א יִמְצְאוּ־ לִ֖י עָוֺ֥ן אֲשֶׁר־ חֵֽטְא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ep̄·ra·yim ’aḵ ‘ā·šar·tî mā·ṣā·ṯî ’ō·wn lî kāl- yə·ḡî·‘ay lō yim·ṣə·’ū- lî ‘ā·wōn ’ă·šer- ḥêṭ
verses.literal: And Ephraim boasts . . . How rich I have become I have found wealth for myself In all my labors they can find in me no iniquity that is sinful
verses.literalPt: Efraim disse: Certamente, estou enriquecido, tenho adquirido para mim riquezas; em todos os meus trabalhos, não acharão em mim iniquidade alguma que seja pecado.

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עֹ֛ד אוֹשִֽׁיבְךָ֥ בָאֳהָלִ֖ים כִּימֵ֥י מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ‘ōḏ ’ō·wō·šî·ḇə·ḵā ḇā·’o·hā·lîm kî·mê mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: But I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt I will again make you dwell . . . in tents as in the days of the appointed feast
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, sou Jeová, teu Deus, desde a terra do Egito; eu ainda te farei habitar de novo em tendas, como nos dias da festa solene.

verses.original: וְדִבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְאָנֹכִ֖י חָז֣וֹן הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי וּבְיַ֥ד הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֲדַמֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bar·tî ‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ḥā·zō·wn hir·bê·ṯî ū·ḇə·yaḏ han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ă·ḏam·meh
verses.literal: I spoke through the prophets and multiplied their visions I gave parables through the prophets
verses.literalPt: Também falei aos profetas, e multipliquei as visões, e, pelo ministério dos profetas, usei de parábolas.

verses.original: אִם־ גִּלְעָ֥ד אָ֙וֶן֙ אַךְ־ שָׁ֣וְא הָי֔וּ בַּגִּלְגָּ֖ל שְׁוָרִ֣ים זִבֵּ֑חוּ גַּ֤ם מִזְבְּחוֹתָם֙ כְּגַלִּ֔ים עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- gil·‘āḏ ’ā·wen ’aḵ- šāw hā·yū bag·gil·gāl šə·wā·rîm zib·bê·ḥū gam miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯām kə·ḡal·lîm ‘al tal·mê śā·ḏāy
verses.literal: Is there iniquity in Gilead They will surely come to nothing Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal Indeed their altars will be heaps of stones in the furrows of the field
verses.literalPt: Acaso, é Gileade iniquidade? São totalmente vaidade. Em Gilgal, sacrificam bois; os seus altares se acham como montões de pedra nos sulcos do campo.

verses.original: וַיִּבְרַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׂדֵ֣ה אֲרָ֑ם וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאִשָּׁ֔ה וּבְאִשָּׁ֖ה שָׁמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·raḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ śə·ḏêh ’ă·rām way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ yiś·rā·’êl bə·’iš·šāh ū·ḇə·’iš·šāh šā·mār
verses.literal: Jacob fled to the land of Aram and Israel worked for a wife for a wife he tended sheep
verses.literalPt: Jacó fugiu para o campo de Arã, e Israel serviu para ter mulher e, para ter mulher, guardou ovelhas.

verses.original: וּבְנָבִ֕יא הֶעֱלָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּבְנָבִ֖יא נִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·ḇî he·‘ĕ·lāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·rā·yim ū·ḇə·nā·ḇî niš·mār
verses.literal: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt and by a prophet he was preserved
verses.literalPt: Por um profeta, Jeová fez a Israel sair do Egito, e, por um profeta, foi Israel preservado.

verses.original: הִכְעִ֥יס אֶפְרַ֖יִם תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים וְדָמָיו֙ עָלָ֣יו יִטּ֔וֹשׁ וְחֶ֨רְפָּת֔וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב ל֖וֹ אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hiḵ·‘îs ’ep̄·ra·yim tam·rū·rîm wə·ḏā·māw ‘ā·lāw yiṭ·ṭō·wōš wə·ḥer·pā·ṯōw yā·šîḇ lōw ’ă·ḏō·nāw
verses.literal: Ephraim has provoked bitter anger so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt upon him and repay him for his contempt
verses.literalPt: Efraim, mui amargamente, provocou-me à ira; portanto, sobre ele será deixado o seu sangue, e o seu Senhor lhe tornará o seu opróbrio.
